name: archsetu-oss
description: ArchSetu open-source analysis engine and CLI (monorepo root)

_overridesComment: Forces patched versions of TRANSITIVE dependencies this repo does not declare itself. Each entry exists because .github/workflows/security.yml gates on `pnpm audit --audit-level=high`; remove an entry once the parent package ships the fix (`pnpm why <pkg>` shows whether it still does anything).

tinypool: vitest 3.2.7 pins ^1.1.1; the fix for two critical prototype-pollution advisories (GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3, GHSA-85c8-ppgw-ccpr) is in 2.1.2. tinypool 2.0.0 had exactly one breaking change - dropping Node 18, which this repo requires >=20 anyway. Verified by running the test suite under the override.
Duplicated in pnpm-workspace.yaml because pnpm 9 reads this field and pnpm 10 reads that file. Keep the two identical.
_auditConfigComment: Advisories acknowledged and ignored, each with its reason. An ignore with no reason is a disabled gate.

CVE-2026-93687 / GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces, stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested patterns): no patched release exists - the advisory lists no fixed version. braces is reached only through fast-glob, with glob patterns this engine authors itself and never from user input, so the malicious-pattern precondition is absent. Re-check when braces publishes a fix, then delete both entries.
Both forms are listed because pnpm 9.4 (the pinned packageManager) honours only ignoreCves; ignoreGhsas arrived in pnpm 9.10 and is what later versions read.
